newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: New Multisource owner sets minority offer.
newsitem.headline: New Multisource owner sets minority offer.

text.p: MDM Growth Investments (Pty) Ltd, which last month bought a 96 percent stake in Multisource Holdings Ltd, on Thursday announced a standby offer to Multisource minority shareholders to buy their shares at 255 cents a share.
MDM said the minority offer would only become operative if the market price per share dropped to below 255 cents a share, net of dealing costs. In this event, a further announcement would be made.
MDM added that since May 16, when a cautionary notice was published, Multisource shares have exceeded the offer price.
